explanation.headline: Adenosine is not on FDA's shortage list; Corvale East has 5.9 days of 3 mg/mL 2 mL vials and Corvale General has 15.4 days

sentences.text: FDA's records show adenosine is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 99 vials of adenosine 3 mg/mL 2 mL at 16.9 vials per day, giving 5.9 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 235 vials of the same presentation at 15.2 vials per day, giving 15.4 days on hand.
Both sites' supply traces to Gland Pharma Limited (NDC 68083015610), a registered plant with VAI inspections through 2024-07-25.
The top-ranked option is to transfer 21 vials of 3 mg/mL 2 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East, which would raise Corvale East to about 7 days while Corvale General retains roughly two weeks.
Alternate manufacturers Eugia US LLC and Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC are not on FDA's shortage list today, but their labels name no plant we could place.
